Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Logistics & Marketing Assistant position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web management, I offer the versatile skill set you seek. My experience includes managing CMS content, creating marketing materials, and coordinating with clients and teams—skills directly applicable to your logistics and marketing needs.

In my freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I have handled order tracking, supplier communication, and administrative tasks while also producing brochures, social media content, and product descriptions. I am proficient in office software and fluent in English, with Dutch at B1 writing level. I am eager to contribute to a family-owned company with international reach.

I am motivated, reliable, and ready to adapt to new challenges. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Logistics & Marketing Assistant role at your company. Although my professional background is in digital marketing, I have developed a strong foundation in both logistics coordination and marketing support through my varied experiences. I am confident that my adaptability and organizational skills make me a strong candidate for this dual-focused position.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I have managed multiple client projects that required tracking deliverables, liaising with suppliers and team members, and handling administrative tasks—similar to the logistics responsibilities outlined. For example, I have coordinated with carriers and suppliers for website assets, maintained shipping documents for e-commerce clients, and ensured timely delivery of content and products. On the marketing side, I have created brochures, social media posts, and product descriptions using Word and Canva, and updated website content regularly. My proficiency with office software, including Word, Excel, and Google Workspace, allows me to handle administrative tasks efficiently.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it offers a blend of logistics and marketing within a family-owned company with international reach. I thrive in close-knit teams and am eager to contribute to a supportive environment. My fluency in English and intermediate Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking) enable me to communicate effectively with carriers, suppliers, and customers in Belgium and abroad. I am punctual, reliable, and quick to learn new systems.

While I have not held a formal logistics title, my hands-on experience in coordinating projects, managing orders, and supporting marketing efforts has prepared me well. I am enthusiastic about bringing my versatile skill set to your team and growing with your company.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your logistics and marketing operations.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Freelance SEO & WordPress: managed client projects, coordinated with suppliers, handled administrative tasks, and created marketing content.
• Junior Digital Marketer: tracked orders and deliveries for e-commerce clients, liaised with carriers, and updated product descriptions.
• Web & SEO Specialist: supported logistics for major retail clients, including order tracking and supplier communication.
• Proficient in office software (Word, Excel, Google Workspace) and CMS platforms for content updates.
• Fluent in English, Dutch at B1 writing level, with strong organizational and adaptability skills.
